formulations.Polymer system Notes: Poly(ethylene carbonate) (PEC), alternating copolymer of CO2 and ethylene oxide. Carbonate content ~95%.
formulations.Transference notes: read from Fig. 1 and Fig. 2; t+ increases with salt concentration up to 80 mol% for LiTFSI
formulations.Notes: Salt concentration range: 5-80 mol%. PEC Mn = 3.7e4 kDa. PEC carbonate content ~95%. Conductivity and transference number data at 80°C only. Li:monomer ratio 5-80 mol% corresponds to [Li+]/[EC] = 1/20 to 1/1.25.
formulations.Reference: Journal of The Electrochemical Society, 162 (2) A3133-A3136 (2015)
